run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion fine-tuning on a custom concept using a dataset of images and a pretrained stable diffusion model
save_textual_inversion_embeddings: save learned textual inversion embeddings to a safetensors file with optional safe serialization
validate_textual_inversion_model: validate a textual inversion model by generating example images from a validation prompt during training
create_textual_inversion_dataset: create a textual inversion dataset with image paths, tokenizer, and configurable learnable property for object or style
save_textual_inversion_model_card: save a model card with generated example images and metadata for a textual inversion model pushed to the hub
